name: dentclinic_appointment_and_recording_system

scripts.deploy: node scripts/assert-no-bypass.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:contrast && npm run check:docs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npx opennextjs-cloudflare build && npm run check:routes && npm run check:size && npm run test:a11y

//overrides: Two packages pin conflicting @emnapi versions inside the wasm32-wasi fallback branch (@unrs/resolver-binding-wasm32-wasi wants 1.10.0 exactly, @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi wants ^1.11.1). npm 11 writes a lock for that graph which its OWN `npm ci` then rejects, so CI could never install. These are WebAssembly fallbacks that are never loaded on x64 Linux, macOS or Windows -- the native bindings win -- so collapsing them onto one version costs nothing. Remove when npm resolves the nested-optional bug.
